task: Bounded C2PA provenance investigation for root-route generated artwork
scope: Inspect the preserved PNG originals under brand/sources/generated, validate embedded C2PA manifests with the official C2PA trust list, compare the signed claims with the registered root-route and REQ-062 model evidence, and record the strict mapping outcome. This review does not edit generation records, model fields, policy, artwork, manifests, exports, or requirements status.

decision.summary: The files contain trusted, OpenAI-signed C2PA manifests whose signed claims identify the OpenAI Media Service claim generator and a software agent named gpt-image version 2.0. The available authoritative model documentation lists the API IDs gpt-image-2 and gpt-image-2-2026-04-21 but does not provide a mapping from the C2PA softwareAgent pair to either ID. C2PA therefore strengthens provider-origin evidence while leaving the exact API model ID and root tool session model unknown.

model_mapping_review.registered_req_062_text: Every artwork generation requests gpt-image-2; actual model evidence resolves to gpt-image-2 or a documented verified snapshot, never an unknown or alternate backend.

signed_c2pa_observation.provider_signer: OpenAI OpCo, LLC / OpenAI Media Service

authoritative_model_catalog.mapping_result: The catalog documents the alias and dated snapshot names but does not state that C2PA softwareAgent name gpt-image version 2.0 is an alias for either name.

model_mapping_review.why_c2pa_is_insufficient_for_req_062: The signed manifest authenticates a claim generator and binds the manifest to the bytes. It does not carry the registered root request model, an API request/response record, a documented alias-resolution envelope, or a provider statement mapping gpt-image version 2.0 to the exact API model IDs accepted by REQ-062.

authoritative_references.title: GPT-Image-2 Model | OpenAI API
authoritative_references.use: Confirms the exact documented alias gpt-image-2 and listed dated snapshot gpt-image-2-2026-04-21.

authoritative_references.title: Provenance signals in OpenAI-generated content
authoritative_references.use: Explains that a trusted C2PA signal can indicate content generated or exported by OpenAI tools, while the verification result does not identify who created the content or establish accuracy, ownership, or context.

authoritative_references.title: C2PA Technical Specification 2.2
authoritative_references.use: Defines signer identity and Trusted state, and defines softwareAgent as the software or hardware used for an action. It does not define softwareAgent as an API model-ID resolution mechanism.

authoritative_references.title: C2PA official trust list used by the verifier
authoritative_references.use: Trust anchors supplied to c2patool for this run.

limitations: A Trusted C2PA manifest attributes the signed claim to the claim generator and signer under the supplied trust model; it does not bind the image to the root image_gen__imagegen session, its user authorization, or an API request trace.
The signed claim says gpt-image version 2.0, not gpt-image-2 or gpt-image-2-2026-04-21. A textual resemblance or version number is not accepted as a model-ID mapping.
All manifests have allActionsIncluded=false, so a consumer cannot infer that the listed action set is complete.

The c2pa.created when values are simple action timestamps; the verifier also reports timeStamp.untrusted for all 122 files because the TSA certificate was not trusted by the supplied list. This does not negate the separately successful claim signature and content-hash checks.
C2PA does not prove prompt fidelity, visual acceptance, source rights, factual correctness, native author identity, or legal clearance.
OpenAI's verification guidance says provenance signals can be removed by editing, conversion, or sharing. This run establishes the state of the preserved local PNG bytes only.

recommendation.record_action: Keep image_model_requested, image_model_observed, image_backend, and alias-evidence fields at their registered root-route values. Do not rewrite the generation ledger from the C2PA softwareAgent label.
recommendation.req_062_action: Keep REQ-062 blocked until a provider request/response or trustworthy provider mapping resolves each required generation to gpt-image-2 or the documented accepted snapshot. C2PA may be attached as supplemental OpenAI-signed provenance evidence.
future_evidence: Preserve the exact provider request or tool trace with model ID and output binding.
If the provider documents a mapping for gpt-image version 2.0, capture that documentation and a policy-approved alias-resolution envelope.
Re-run this scan after any byte-changing export and keep each new C2PA report bound to the resulting file hash.
